title: द्वितीयोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 2 · Sanjaya describes the Kaurava dismay

summary.en: Sanjaya tells how, with Drona dead, Duryodhana's sons and warriors lost heart, and recalls Drona's wealth of strength. He says Drona was killed by the Panchala prince after fighting on to the end.
summary.kn: ದ್ರೋಣ ಸತ್ತ ನಂತರ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಮಕ್ಕಳು, ವೀರರು ಧೈರ್ಯ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡುದನ್ನೂ ದ್ರೋಣನ ಬಲದ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನೂ ಸಂಜಯ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೊನೆಯವರೆಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ದ್ರೋಣನನ್ನು ಪಾಂಚಾಲ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ಕೊಂದನೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: संजय बताते हैं कि द्रोण के मरने पर दुर्योधन के पुत्र और योद्धा हताश हो गए, और वे द्रोण के बल का स्मरण करते हैं। वे कहते हैं कि अन्त तक लड़ते द्रोण को पाञ्चाल राजकुमार ने मारा।
summary.te: ద్రోణుడు చనిపోయాక దుర్యోధనుని కుమారులు, వీరులు ధైర్యం కోల్పోయారని, ద్రోణుని బల సంపదను సంజయుడు గుర్తు చేస్తాడు. చివరి వరకు పోరాడిన ద్రోణుని పాంచాల రాకుమారుడు చంపాడని చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: த்ரோணர் இறந்ததும் துரியோதனனின் மக்களும் வீரரும் மனம் தளர்ந்ததையும் த்ரோணரின் வலிமையையும் சஞ்சயன் நினைவுகூர்கிறான். இறுதிவரை போரிட்ட த்ரோணரைப் பாஞ்சால இளவரசன் கொன்றான் என்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ദ്രോണൻ മരിച്ചതോടെ ദുര്യോധനന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരും വീരന്മാരും ധൈര്യം നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു; ദ്രോണന്റെ മഹാബലം അദ്ദേഹം ഓർക്കുന്നു. പാഞ്ചാല രാജകുമാരൻ അവസാനംവരെ പൊരുതിയ ശേഷമാണ് ദ്രോണൻ കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ടതെന്നും സഞ്ജയൻ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.2; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
हते द्रोणे महेष्वासे तव पुत्रा महारथाः ।
बभूवुराश्वस्तमुखा विषण्णा गतचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: When the great archer Drona was killed, your sons, the great chariot-fighters, grew pale-faced, despondent and lost in confusion.

verses.text:
अवाङ्मुखाः शस्त्रभृतः सर्व एव विशां पते ।
अप्रेक्षमाणाः शोकार्ता नाभ्यभाषन्परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: All the weapon-bearers, O lord of the people, stood with heads bowed, not looking up, stricken with grief, and spoke not a word to one another.

verses.text:
तान्दृष्ट्वा व्यथिताकारान्सैन्यानि तव भारत ।
ऊर्ध्वमेवाभ्यवेक्षन्त दुःखत्रस्तान्यनेकशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them so downcast, O Bharata, your armies, many of them frightened by sorrow, kept gazing upward at the sky.

verses.text:
शस्त्राण्येषां च राजेन्द्र शोणिताक्तान्यशेषतः ।
प्राभ्रश्यन्त कराग्रेभ्यो दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं निपातितम् ॥

meaning.en: And their weapons, O king of kings, all stained with blood, slipped from their fingertips when they saw Drona felled.

verses.text:
तानि बद्धान्यनिष्टानि लम्बमानानि भारत ।
अदृश्यन्त महाराज नक्षत्राणि यथा दिवि ॥

meaning.en: Hanging from their straps, those unlucky weapons looked, great king, like stars in the sky.

verses.text:
तथार्तं स्तिमितं दृष्ट्वा गतसत्त्वमिव स्थितम् ।
स्वं बलं तन्महाराज राजा दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his own force so afflicted, hushed and standing as if lifeless, King Duryodhana spoke to it.

verses.text:
भवतां बाहुवीर्यं हि समाश्रित्य मया युधि ।
पाण्डवेयाः समाहूता युद्धं चेदं प्रवर्तितम् ॥

meaning.en: "It was relying on the strength of your arms that I challenged the Pandavas and began this war.

verses.text:
तदिदं निहते द्रोणे विषण्णमिव लक्ष्यते ।
युध्यमानाश्च समरे योधा वध्यन्ति सर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Now that Drona is dead, it seems to be dispirited; yet warriors who fight in battle are killed everywhere.

verses.text:
जयो वापि वधो वापि युध्यमानस्य संयुगे ।
भवेत्किमत्र चित्रं वै युध्यध्वं सर्वतोमुखाः ॥

meaning.en: Victory or death comes to one who fights in battle; what is surprising in that? Fight on, facing every direction.

verses.text:
पश्यध्वं च महात्मानं कर्णं वैकर्तनं युधि ।
प्रचरन्तं महेष्वासं दिव्यैरस्त्रैर्महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: Look at the great-souled Karna, Vaikartana, mighty archer, moving about in battle with divine weapons.

verses.text:
यस्य वै युधि संत्रासात्कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः ।
निवर्तते सदामर्षात्सिंहात्क्षुद्रमृगो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Through fear of him in battle, Dhananjaya the son of Kunti, however angry, always turns back, like a small beast before a lion.

verses.text:
येन नागायुतप्राणो भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
मानुषेणैव युद्धेन तामवस्थां प्रवेशितः ॥

meaning.en: By him Bhimasena, mighty and with the strength of ten thousand elephants, was brought to that state, though he fought only as a man.

verses.text:
येन दिव्यास्त्रविच्छूरो मायावी स घटोत्कचः ।
अमोघया रणे शक्त्या निहतो भैरवं नदन् ॥

meaning.en: By him the heroic and illusion-wielding Ghatotkacha, skilled in divine weapons, was killed in battle with his unfailing spear as he roared dreadfully.

verses.text:
तस्य दुष्पारवीर्यस्य सत्यसंधस्य धीमतः ।
बाह्वोर्द्रविणमक्षय्यमद्य द्रक्ष्यथ संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Today you will see in battle the inexhaustible wealth of arms of that wise, truthful man whose valour none can fathom.

verses.text:
द्रोणपुत्रस्य विक्रान्तं राधेयस्यैव चोभयोः ।
पाण्डुपाञ्चालसैन्येषु द्रक्ष्यथापि महात्मनोः ॥

meaning.en: You will also see the prowess of those two great souls, Drona's son and Radha's son, among the Pandava and Panchala armies.

verses.text:
सर्व एव भवन्तश्च शूराः प्राज्ञाः कुलोद्गताः ।
शीलवन्तः कृतास्त्राश्च द्रक्ष्यथाद्य परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: All of you are brave, wise, well-born, of good character and trained in arms; today you will see one another's worth."

verses.text:
एवमुक्ते महाराज कर्णो वैकर्तनो नृपः ।
सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः प्रायुध्यत महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: When this was said, great king, the mighty King Karna Vaikartana gave a loud lion's roar and fought.

verses.text:
स सृञ्जयानां सर्वेषां पाञ्चालानां च पश्यताम् ।
केकयानां विदेहानामकरोत्कदनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Before the eyes of all the Srinjayas, Panchalas, Kekayas and Videhas, he wrought great carnage.

verses.text:
तस्येषुधाराः शतशः प्रादुरासञ्शरासनात् ।
अग्रे पुङ्खे च संसक्ता यथा भ्रमरपङ्क्तयः ॥

meaning.en: Streams of arrows came by hundreds from his bow, clinging at tip and feather like rows of bees.

verses.text:
स पीडयित्वा पाञ्चालान्पाण्डवांश्च तरस्विनः ।
हत्वा सहस्रशो योधानर्जुनेन निपातितः ॥

meaning.en: Having oppressed the Panchalas and the swift Pandavas and killed thousands of warriors, he was brought down by Arjuna.
